chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh, Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem, and Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Tatana - may God be pleased with them - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn Abi al-Fath al-Tamimi, who said: 'My Master Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (peace be upon him) narrated that his father (peace be upon him) quoted on the authority of his forefathers (peace be upon him), on the authority of Ali (peace be upon him) from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)'

He said: 'Whoever likes to look at the red hyacinth stem that God planted with His own hand [and hold fast to it] should accept the authority of Ali and the Imams from his progeny, for they are the chosen ones of God, the Exalted and Mighty, and His purified ones, and they are the infallibles from every sin and fault.'

key_terms.الْقَضِيبِ الْيَاقُوتِ الْأَحْمَرِ: The red hyacinth stem, a metaphor for the Imams
key_terms.غَرَسَهُ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ: Planted by God with His own hand, indicating divine selection

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the red hyacinth stem in Shia hadith regarding the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Imam al-Rida (a.s.) to Imam Ali (a.s.), employs the metaphor of the 'red hyacinth stem' (Qadhib al-Yaqut al-Ahmar) planted by God’s own hand to signify the divine selection and unique spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt. It emphasizes that their Wilayah is the means for believers to attain closeness to God, characterizing them as the 'Chosen Ones' (Khayrat Allah) and 'Pure Ones' (Safatuh) who are Ma'sum (infallible) from all sin and error.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-211 Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh, Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem and Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Tatana - may God be pleased with them - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ali al-Tamimi, ‘My Master Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) narrated that his father (a.s.) quoted on the authority of his forefathers (a.s.), on the authority of Ali (a.s.) that the Prophet (S) said,

“Whoever likes to grab the stem of a red hyacinth that God has planted Himself should wholeheartedly seek the Mastery of Ali (a.s.) and the Immaculate Leaders from his progeny, as they are the ones chosen by the Honorable the Exalted God. They are purified of all sins and faults.”
